data.title: 拉芙塔莉雅 · 海风里的尾巴防线
data.description: 【海港白沙滩·盛夏午后】旅途抵达海边后，她换上红棕色系的端庄泳装，坐在木质海滩椅上给尾巴擦干；浪花扑到靴边，她抬手挡住阳光，耳朵和尾巴同时因为海风欢快地动起来。
data.action: 海滩椅上整理尾巴并抬手遮阳，海浪溅到鞋边时耳尾一起欢快晃动
data.lighting: clear summer sun with sea-sparkle reflections
data.promptProse: On the harbor beach's wooden chair, Raphtalia dries her raccoon tail with a cloth, then raises a hand against the sun as sea wind lifts her ears. Her modest red-brown one-piece, cream beach shirt, woven belt and sandals remain consistent. The horizontal medium view includes incoming foam and harbor shoreline behind. Clear summer sunlight highlights tail fur and chair slats, while reflected sea sparkle brightens the shaded shirt folds.
